editorial:
You follow Surly, a grumpy squirrel who gets kicked out of his park and has to survive in the city. He stumbles on Maury's Nut Store, which could feed the whole park through winter. The movie has a fun, colorful vibe with lots of slapstick humor and a cast of quirky animal characters. It feels like a classic cartoon adventure with plenty of chase scenes and silly moments that kids will love and parents can enjoy too.

The animation is bright and lively, and the voice cast brings energy to every scene. The pacing moves quickly, though some jokes land better than others. It is not deep or groundbreaking, but it delivers solid family fun. If you want a light movie night with the kids, this is a good pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Surly and his friends pull off a big heist at Maury's Nut Store, but they discover the store is actually a front for bank robbers. The animals team up to stop the criminals and save the nuts. In the end, Surly earns his place back in the park, and the community learns to work together. The twist is that the nut store was never just about nuts, it was a cover for a robbery all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family comedies with slapstick humor.
